proposals.before: When Emperor Wuzong raised troops in the northern steppe, Yahudou asked that his son Tele Temür accompany him.
proposals.after: When Emperor Wuzong raised troops in the northern steppe, he asked that Yahudou's son Tele Temür accompany him.
proposals.reason: The Chinese 請 has Emperor Wuzong as its continuing subject; the current idiomatic version wrongly makes Yahudou the requester.

proposals.before: Yan Temür succeeded at the age of twelve. His consort was of the Kongirat clan, granddaughter of the consort of Prince Haqar and a cousin of Empress Sugeshili.
proposals.after: Yan Temür succeeded at the age of twelve. His consort was of the Kongirat clan, granddaughter of the imperial son-in-law Haqar and a cousin of Empress Sugeshili.
proposals.reason: 哈只兒駙馬 means the imperial son-in-law Haqar; it does not mean the consort of a Prince Haqar.

decisions.reason: In s0084, 武宗 is the subject of 撫兵 and continues as the subject of 請; the idiomatic wrongly makes Yahudou the requester, while the repair correctly has Wuzong ask that Yahudou's son Tele Temür accompany him.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 武宗撫兵漠北，請以子脫列帖木兒從

decisions.reason: 哈只兒駙馬 names Haqar as an imperial son-in-law (駙馬); the idiomatic misreads this as the consort of a Prince Haqar, and the proposed replacement is accurate.
